label: For "Clinical Trial Patient Matching": Match patients to eligible trials by reasoning over structured and unstructured records against inclusion and exclusion criteria. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Gold set from a single disease area.
